visual_synopsis: This appears to be a COMPILATION of several unrelated sketches: a young man in sunglasses trading words through car windows with an older driver in a battered Soviet truck; a scruffy long-haired man marched by a uniformed officer into a police station and interrogated by a mustached captain at his desk; an office and then a football pitch where a squad in red Armenia-style kit, including a Black player, trains and a goalkeeper dives; two men in plaid shirts working a roadside grape stall on a country road while a man in a black suit rants beside an SUV; and an apartment where an old man in a hat and glasses banters with a young woman in a blue top.
